title: Integrate the shared spatial epoch into production runtime
requires: Host capable of building the Slang CPU/reference driver and running native runtime tests
scope: Repair the rejected realtime-single-step-v1 candidate by binding the F8-05--10 shared spatial service to production SimulationRuntime resource plans and native dispatch, while leaving legacy-default behavior unchanged. Follow docs/roadmap/evidence/F8-23-CANDIDATE-REJECTION.md; this task does not advertise the public profile or refreeze a candidate.
acceptance: Production realtime state stages canonical leaves for every present advertised domain, performs at most one build/refit, publishes exactly one generation-tagged epoch including empty ticks, and pins that epoch for all domain and coupling consumers.

Boundary births, removals, replacements and transfers remain atomic; overflow, invalid identity and envelope escape preserve the prior committed epoch/state and cannot trigger a retry, second update, host readback or wait.

Native CPU execution covers its required rigid/query subset, while unsupported CPU domains remain explicit; every compiled native adapter still builds against the common runtime and legacy-default regressions remain unchanged.
Tests exercise empty, sparse, crossing, lifecycle, capacity and failure recovery through production runtime seams and verify actual epoch counters rather than a model-only backend.
